source: Abercrombie & Fitch – Baggy Jean model shot
pieces: blue/grey suede low trainers with gum sole
formula: Cream top + ecru baggy jeans + coloured suede sneaker + cap
why: A near-tonal cream-on-ecru base makes the blue suede trainers the single colour pop, exactly where he likes it. The textured waffle henley keeps an all-light outfit from looking flat.
fit_for_him: His knit/tee + light jeans + Spezials, but go full ecru on the bottom and let a blue Spezial or Gazelle be the only colour.

source: Kith – Denim from Spring 2026 editorial
pieces: light-wash wide jeans with front seam
formula: Light denim harrington + soft-colour shirt + matching light jeans + shirt-coloured suede sneaker
why: Double denim done in one pale wash reads deliberate, and the mauve shirt is echoed exactly by the suede sneakers. That colour echo is the trick that makes it look styled rather than thrown on.
fit_for_him: His harrington + light jeans, but with a matching-wash denim jacket and a burgundy/mauve shirt picked up by the shoe colour.

source: END. Clothing – adidas Firebird Tracktop (model shot)
pieces: cream army-style trainers with gum sole
formula: Coloured track jacket + white tee + washed grey jeans + cream gum trainers
why: The track jacket is the one special piece; everything else is muted so the green does the talking. Grey-green denim instead of blue keeps it softer and more Copenhagen than sporty.
fit_for_him: His track-style jacket + boxy tee + grey baggy jeans; swap the cream trainers for his Spezials or Gazelles.

source: Abercrombie & Fitch – Pleated Baggy Trouser model shot
formula: Cropped tan blouson + Breton tee + olive pleated trousers + cream sneakers
why: A textured tan jacket over a Breton stripe is old-money casual without any tailoring, and olive pleats are softer than chinos. Tan, olive and navy are three earthy colours that never clash.
fit_for_him: His harrington/suede bomber + striped top + pleated trousers, done in tan and olive; wear with Premiata-type suede sneakers.

source: END. Clothing – Represent Lightweight Alpaca Knit Jumper (model shot)
formula: Fuzzy neutral knit + light jeans + belt + suede trainers
why: Same knit-plus-light-jeans formula he already wears, but a brushed alpaca texture makes it feel expensive. The black belt adds a sharp line between two pale halves.
fit_for_him: His crew knit + light jeans + Spezials, upgraded with a fuzzy alpaca/mohair-blend knit and a visible belt.

source: END. Clothing – Drôle de Monsieur Lace Knitted Shirt (model shot)
pieces: cream army-style trainers with gum sole
formula: Open-knit camp shirt + mid-blue jeans + cream gum trainers
why: A crochet-style knit shirt in sage is the summer version of his knit polos, and the texture alone makes jeans-and-trainers look dressed up for a night out.
fit_for_him: His crochet polo + jeans + Spezials, but in a sage open-knit camp shirt worn alone with the collar open.

source: END. Clothing – Portuguese Flannel Spring Embroidery Vacation Shirt (model shot)
pieces: ecru camp-collar shirt with small floral embroidery
formula: Ecru camp shirt + mid jeans + suede clogs
why: Small embroidery is a quiet detail instead of a loud print, and suede clogs make plain jeans feel like a summer outfit.
fit_for_him: His camp-collar shirt + baggy jeans, with his Boston clogs; pick an ecru shirt with a small embroidered detail.

source: END. Clothing – Portuguese Flannel Linen Camp Vacation Shirt (model shot)
formula: Light-blue linen camp shirt + ecru jeans + brown suede clogs
why: Light blue against ecru is one of the most flattering summer pairs, and brown suede grounds it. Linen keeps it relaxed but still neat.
fit_for_him: His linen shirt + cream trousers + Bostons, with the shirt in light blue and worn open-collar on its own.

source: END. Clothing – adidas Resort Knitted Polo Shirt (model shot)
pieces: navy open-knit polo with white Johnny collar and 3-stripe sleeves
cream army-style trainers with gum sole
formula: Knit Johnny-collar polo + brown wide trousers + cream trainers
why: Navy and brown together is classic and a little unexpected; the white collar lifts it at the face. Wide brown trousers make a sporty knit look grown-up for dinner.
fit_for_him: His knit polo/Johnny collar + relaxed pleated trousers; do it in navy over brown with his Gazelles or Spezials.

source: END. Clothing – adidas Pleated Pant (model shot)
pieces: grey suede trainers with burgundy laces
formula: Fuzzy brown knit polo + sage pleated trousers + grey suede trainers
why: A brushed knit polo is the most grown-up casual top there is, and brown with sage is a rich autumn pairing. The burgundy laces are a tiny second accent.
fit_for_him: His knit polo + relaxed pleated trousers + suede sneakers, in brown over sage; very close to what he owns.

source: Abercrombie & Fitch – Corduroy Zip Shirt Jacket model shot
colours: forest green, cream, mid blue, tan
formula: Cord overshirt-jacket + cream shirt + baggy jeans + suede clogs
why: Corduroy adds texture, and green with cream and tan feels outdoorsy-classy. Clogs keep it relaxed on warm September days.
fit_for_him: His cropped cord jacket + baggy jeans + Bostons; use a deep green or brown cord and a cream shirt underneath.

source: END. Clothing – adidas EQT Track Top (model shot)
pieces: black Samba-type trainers with tan stripes
formula: Cord track jacket + dark tee + rinse jeans + dark Sambas
why: It is his track-jacket formula done in corduroy, so it has autumn texture. Rust on dark indigo is warm and the dark trainers keep it grounded.
fit_for_him: His track-style jacket + baggy jeans + Sambas, swapping nylon for a cord track top in rust or brown.

source: Arket – Relaxed Canvas Trousers (model shot)
pieces: cream Samba-type trainers with black stripes
formula: Cropped navy jacket + brown collar layer + dark relaxed trousers + cream Sambas
why: Smart layering: the brown collar shows inside a navy cropped jacket, an easy colour pairing. The cream trainers lighten a dark outfit for evening.
fit_for_him: His harrington + knit polo + relaxed trousers + Sambas; let the polo collar sit over the jacket collar.

source: Kith – Denim from Fall 2025 editorial
pieces: light-blue suede and white trainers with gum sole
colours: mid blue, light blue, white, gum
formula: Boxy denim jacket + same-wash jeans + light-blue suede trainers
why: Matched-wash double denim with a boxy jacket and a full straight leg; light-blue suede trainers echo the denim, so it is all one colour story.
fit_for_him: His baggy mid jeans + Spezials, adding a cropped boxy denim jacket in the same wash.

source: Abercrombie & Fitch – Baggy Jean model shot
formula: Boxy dark hoodie + light baggy jeans + unusual suede trainers + cap
why: The plainest weekend uniform made special by one unexpected sneaker; the hoodie's boxy, cropped length keeps the baggy jean proportion right.
fit_for_him: His hoodie + light baggy jeans + cap; the upgrade is his green/pink Spezial as the only statement.

source: Arket – Quilted Down Jacket (model shot)
pieces: grey marl crew sweatshirt with white tee hem
formula: Quilted navy jacket + grey sweatshirt + rinse jeans + cream trainers
why: A flat onion-quilt jacket is sleeker than a puffy puffer, and navy, grey and indigo is the easiest cold-weather palette. A peek of white tee at the hem finishes it.
fit_for_him: His quilted jacket + sweatshirt + dark jeans; wear his Spezials or Gazelles instead of the cream trainers.

source: END. Clothing – adidas EQT Vest (model shot)
colours: black, chocolate brown, vintage blue, cream
formula: Puffer vest over brown knit + vintage baggy jeans + Sambas
why: A vest over a knit shows off the sleeve texture and colour, and brown under black is richer than all-black. Vintage-wash denim adds character.
fit_for_him: His puffer vest + knit + baggy jeans + Sambas; choose a brown or burgundy knit under it.

source: END. Clothing – Represent Funnel Neck Puffer Jacket (model shot)
formula: Black puffer + cream tee + light jeans + sand suede sneakers
why: Black over cream and light denim gives high contrast without colour, and sand suede sneakers stop the puffer feeling sporty.
fit_for_him: His puffer + boxy tee + light jeans; pick a plain cream heavyweight tee and Premiata-type sand suede sneakers.

source: Kith – Fall 2025 lookbook
pieces: navy knit polo with white tipping
formula: Tweed zip blouson + tipped knit polo + navy trousers + suede trainers
why: Tweed gives old-money texture without any tailoring, cut as a short zip blouson. Tipped collar and hem show neatly from under the jacket.
fit_for_him: His bomber + knit polo + relaxed trousers + Sambas; try a tweed/wool zip blouson in grey.

source: Abercrombie & Fitch – baggy trouser model shot
formula: Cropped black sweatshirt + white tee hem + black wide trousers + Sambas
why: Tonal black with one sliver of white tee and light Sambas looks sharp for evening. The cropped sweatshirt over a full-length trouser is the proportion he likes.
fit_for_him: His sweatshirt + black jeans/trousers + Sambas, with a white tee hem visible below a cropped sweatshirt.

source: Arket – 2-in-1 Quilted Liner Vest (model shot)

why: A tonal navy outfit looks considered with almost no effort, and the quilting adds texture. The light trainers are the only break.
